featured_reviews.review_text: यहां पर बाइक मोडिफिकेशन की जानकारी नहीं है तो पर v वे हां बोल देते हैं और उसके बाद पार्ट्स को खोलकर वापस से कसना पड़ता है, मै यहां अपने बाइक में क्रैश गार्ड, फुट रेस्ट और saddle stay ke liye gya the, उन्होंने क्रैश गार्ड सही से लगाया, लेकिन footrest को इतना वाहियात और बिना लॉजिक और ज्ञान के कसा कि इतना जोर से आवाज आए बाइक से झटका लगे कि शायद मुझे लगा कुछ टूट गया हो, लेकिन बाद में मैने यूट्यूब से समझा उन्होंने क्या किया एक तरफ का nut soccer wala jo बाहर parts आता है उसमें कसा और एक nut को saree गार्ड me kasa jisse soccer jab bike चलते समय नीचे जाए तो दोनों में खिंचाव पैदा हो और पूरी बाइक imbalance हो जाए और खट खट की आवाज आए और पार्ट्स v थोड़ा टेढ़ा हुआ, जब मैने दूसरी बार saddle stay लगवाने gya, to bina जानकारी के उसने हां कहकर पार्ट्स खोल दिया, फिर वापस से उसने कसा तो इतना ज्यादा ओवरटाइट कर दिया nut को टेढ़ा रखके बिना बासर के जिससे टेढ़ा हुआ, जैसे लग रहा हो स्टाफ काम नहीं कर रहा हो वो भड़ास निकाल रहा हो, और जब शुरू में खोलना था तब उसने टाइट कर रहा था जैसे कस्टमर को पता ही नहीं चल रहा है इतना नॉनसेंस मैकेनिक है। मै इसे recommend नहीं करूंगा, क्योंकि मेरा एक्सपीरियंस ठीक काम होने का 30% ही है।। उनलोगों से ज्यादा बेसिक knowledge apne log ke paas hai👍
featured_reviews.review_translated_text: I don't know about bike modification here, but they say yes and then the parts have to be opened and tightened again. I went here to get the crash guard, footrest and saddle stay installed on my bike. They fitted the crash guard properly, but the footrest was tightened so badly and without any logic or knowledge that it made such a loud noise that the bike jolted, that I thought something might have broken. But later I understood from YouTube what they did, they tightened one side nut on the soccer nut which is an external part and tightened another nut on the saree guard so that when the soccer goes down while riding, there is tension between the two and the whole bike gets imbalanced and there is a rattling sound and the parts also get a little bent. When I went to get the saddle stay installed for the second time, without any knowledge, they said yes and opened the parts. featured_reviews.review_text:
**“⚠️ Strong caution for all customers considering Desi Mechi / Bikers Pad.
My experience raised serious concerns about transparency, pricing clarity, documentation, and overall customer handling. When I asked basic questions about the benefits of servicing here versus Honda BigWing (the authorised service centre for Honda H’ness), the responses kept changing. Labour charges were bundled with spare parts without a proper cost breakdown.

Despite repeated requests, no OEM invoice or warranty for the parts was not assured. Worse, no invoice was given for the pick-and-drop charges, even after I specifically asked for it. This felt highly irregular and unprofessional.

For comparison, I later completed the same service at Honda BigWing for half price quoted by desi mechi, where everything was properly billed, transparent, and documented. The difference in process and professionalism was very clear.

What added to the disappointment was that after they themselves refused to service the vehicle, I was still charged money just to get my bike returned — again without any invoice or documentation.This is illegal.

Based on my experience, I would strongly advise customers to avoid choosing this service provider and opt for more transparent, reliable alternatives.
The earlier positive reviews did not match the reality I faced and seemed very different from what actually happened.

Please verify with authorised service dealers regarding actual service costs, warranty on parts, and warranty on service before deciding. This will help ensure you get clear billing, genuine parts, and proper documentation.

Sharing this so others can make an informed decision based on my real experience.”**
